title: The Value of System 1 Models in Medicine
abstract: arXiv:2610.31315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many clinical decisions are a choice among a few fixed options, taken quickly and in large numbers. Such decisions also need an uncertainty estimate to know when to defer to a clinician. Generative language models answer slowly in free text and state their confidence poorly. In contrast, System 1 models answer zero-shot with a probability for each answer. However, their performance across clinical tasks is unknown. Four System 1 models, two proprietary and two with open weights, were evaluated zero-shot on 86 public tasks from 14 clinical domains in 20 languages, spanning examination questions and medical imaging. Tasks were assigned to six capability tiers before analysis. The primary outcome was the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUROC). translated_title: 系统1模型在医学中的价值
translated_abstract: 许多临床决策是在少数固定选项之间做出的选择，需要快速、大量地完成。此类决策还需要不确定性估计，以便知道何时应转交给临床医生处理。生成式语言模型以自由文本形式回答速度较慢，且对自身置信度的表达不佳。相比之下，系统1模型能够以零样本方式作答，并为每个选项给出概率。然而，这类模型在各类临床任务中的表现尚不清楚。本研究评估了四个系统1模型（两个专有模型和两个开放权重模型）在86个公开任务上的零样本表现，这些任务来自14个临床领域、20种语言，涵盖考试题目和医学影像。在分析之前，任务被划分为六个能力层级。主要结局指标为受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC），次要结局指标包括校准度、语言效应，以及与已发表结果和生成式模型的比较。在179,111个病例中，最佳模型的平均AUROC……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究首次大规模评估了四个系统1模型在20种语言、14个临床领域共86个任务上的零样本表现，表明这类能快速输出概率并具备不确定性估计能力的模型，在临床决策中具有独特价值。
en_tdlr: This study evaluated four System 1 models zero-shot on 86 public clinical tasks across 14 domains and 20 languages, demonstrating their unique value for fast, probability-based clinical decision-making with built-in uncertainty estimation.
